verdict.rationale: Publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair ask for a developer-facing, agent-driven tool like ReelMimic, so the axis applies. The pack never mentions an llms.txt file or agent-targeted documentation, and the probe for a Markdown version of the docs returned HTTP 404. Markdown style files and the use of Claude Code/Codex as builders are adjacent features, not docs an agent can be pointed at.
